title: tpu-code-arm Result
description: Output payload of the tpu-code-arm agent: a vllm_torchtpu commit on the gap's branch with the probes behind it, an evidenced refutation, or why there is neither.

oneOf.description: changed: outputs match, the op is faster, the review passed

status.description: 'changed': the change is committed, the plugin imports, the op's outputs match the incumbent's and it is faster than it by more than the larger of noise_floor_pct and the probes' spreads; tpu-critical-review passed the claim. 'refuted': the outputs do not match, or the plugin does not import, after one fix; or the op is not faster above that threshold. 'blocked': the fix needs something outside the vllm_torchtpu plugin, tpu-code-stack refused the commit, no slot could be claimed, or tpu-critical-review did not pass the claim. 'invalid_input': the request cannot be run as given; every gap is in `missing`. 'failed': infrastructure failed past the relaunch limit, or a probe's applier exited 4 (`base mismatch`), never `refuted`. Every slot claimed is released before any of them is returned.

summary.description: The change and the op's before and after in one line.

plugin.description: The change: the gap's branch and the commit tpu-code-stack made of it, `patch` its `git diff base..sha`.

ref.description: The branch or tag measured, e.g. `stack`, `hyp/2-moe-gate`.

sha.description: The commit `ref` named when it was measured.

patch.description: `git diff base..sha` as plugin_source.py diff wrote it: the one patch the job applies, kept so the arm replays without the repo.

evidence.description: What the probes measured, on the stack head's image, against the incumbent (the stack head's own plugin).

probe_jobs.description: Every probe job id, incumbent and candidate.

commits.description: Every commit the arm made on the gap's branch, in order; the caller discards one test per entry.

op_before_ms.description: The op's time per occurrence on the incumbent (measured).

op_after_ms.description: The op's time per occurrence on the candidate (measured).

outputs_match.description: The op's outputs match the incumbent's on the gap's shapes.

review.description: tpu-critical-review's report for the `kind: claim` review.

missing.description: What the caller must change, when status is 'invalid_input'.

run_id.description: Identifier of the active TPU agent suite run namespace.

examples.summary: One sorted gather in _gather_tokens: moe_gather 61.0 -> 38.4 us per occurrence, outputs bitwise equal.
The sorted gather reorders tokens the combine step reads in expert order: outputs differ after one fix.
The copy is emitted by torch_tpu, outside the vllm_torchtpu plugin.
examples.reason: fix outside plugin: torch_tpu's lowering of index_select emits the copy.
